messages.subject: coord_equal() messes up axis
parts:
Hi,

axis labels etc are off with coord_equal(), it is easy to see from an
example:

graafikuks<-data.frame(x=c(0:5), y=c(5:0))
p<-ggplot(graafikuks, aes(x,y))
p<-p+geom_point()
p<-p+coord_equal()
p

first point should be at (0,5) but appears somewhere (-0,25, 5,25)
instead, other points are off too. Without coord_equal() everything
appears as expected.

This seems to be regression in 0.85, it worked in 0.84 (or in 0.83, at
least my previous graphs looked right).

btw - it seems, that the issues are mostly reported here, not in
github? Would it be better to report them in http://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/
instead?

Indrek
